content.scenario: The Central Government appoints an Additional Director-General to assist in investigations under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019. The Director-General delegates some of his powers to the Additional Director-General to conduct inquiries.
content.outcome: The Additional Director-General exercises his powers subject to the general control, supervision, and direction of the Director-General, and conducts inquiries or investigations under the Act.

user_queries: What are the powers of the Additional Director-General?
Can the Director-General delegate powers to the Additional Director-General?
What is the role of the Additional Director-General in investigations?
